subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should closure require only the focused persistent active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb, or the broader live-target proof and optional switch-feedback controls described in the issue discussion?
rationale: Current main lacks persistent workspace context in the header and the open PR covers the focused breadcrumb, but the issue body and comment broaden the closure bar beyond a visual label.

options.title: Accept Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Land or replace the workspace-breadcrumb PR and track session generation, input cursor, writable target, quick-switch, and message-prefix ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden Closure Criteria
options.body: Keep this issue open until the Dashboard proves the fuller live target tuple and switch feedback in one implementation.

options.title: Reject Header Expansion
options.body: Keep /agent, /status, and the workspace rail as the supported workflow and close the linked PR by explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Land or replace the workspace-breadcrumb PR and track session generation, input cursor, writable target, quick-switch, and message-prefix ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the current active-agent header breadcrumb that this issue would extend or constrain.
